description: This is a wip test using GATE. GATE is an open-source Monte Carlo simulation platform designed for modeling and simulating medical imaging systems, radiotherapy, and radiation dosimetry. It extends Geant4 with features tailored for time-dependent simulations, imaging physics, and therapy modeling. The documentation entry point is available here.
